mainText: Today’s priority is a software supply chain attack affecting Q-Dir and DesktopOK. AhnLab confirms that installers and updates from the official distribution path delivered remote-access malware. Check endpoint inventories and update history. Compare suspect files with the researcher’s hashes and investigate Python malware, scheduled tasks and unusual connections. Isolate devices with confirmed infection indicators. Reinstalling the utility alone may leave malware behind. No named customer deployment or Caribbean victim was confirmed. Earlier firewall, Drupal and identity stories had no verified material change in this check. Regional, vendor and exploited-vulnerability catalog coverage was incomplete.
